the street part's start ($1390 jumps here) and the title sequence: sets up the title ($1F99), starts the title tune ($13F9) and shows the credits, the title and Freddy's picture in turn ($2088), stopping early at a key; then silences the tune (effect 34) and offers the start menu ($3894): a new game goes to the character select ($225E), Springwood ($378B, $325F) and the walk through the street ($1F24), dying there brings back the title, and reaching the house ends at $1EC1; a saved game is loaded from side 2 first

"LOAD THE SAVED GAME": asks for side 2, waits for a key, and tries SAVE.DAT with the Kernal's LOAD ($0C56); missing, "UNABLE TO FIND THE SAVED GAME." shows and the menu comes back; found, it is loaded to $9800 and its first 24 bytes, the party, copied to $4D10; the character set and screen are loaded and the screen drawn ($306C)
$1FEA's arguments: $9800 to $4D10, $18 bytes, the saved party
after the saved party is copied: loads MON (file 0) and SCREEN (file 4, the street's screen) and puts SCREEN up from $9000 plus $0800 ($306C)

hands over to the house: puts the sprites and memory in order ($1F44), pushes $138F as the return address, passes the character ($4D1A to $0C4F), the health ($4D14 to $0C4E) and the sound switch ($4F9A to $0C4C), and loads MAIN, the house part (file 5), whose RTS lands on its entry at $1390
"PLEASE INSERT SIDE 2 AND HIT A KEY" and a return, then at $1F05 "UNABLE TO FIND THE SAVED GAME."
the walk through the street, a pass at a time: waits two frames, the player's turn ($267A), and unless that ended the walk ($4E7B), the street's events ($2862) and the display ($325F)

the street's set-up: black border and background, the multicolours, the screen ($CC00) and colour RAM ($D800) pointers, no Kernal messages ($9D), the sprites off, BASIC switched out, the case switch locked (CHR$(8)), the random generator seeded from the jiffy clock, every key repeating ($028A), the message timer set, and the scratch command template copied into the loader ($0C64)

copies the template into the loader's scratch command from the end, X bytes on from the start; X comes from the byte at $0014 (an absolute LDX where LDX #$14 was surely meant), so with 0 there only the S is copied; the "0:" is already in place in the loader's own file, and $0E3D copies each name in after it
"S0:" and fifteen spaces, the template of the loader's scratch command

shows picture A (0 the credits at $B000, 1 the title at $A000, 2 Freddy's bitmap) for X times 8 waits of 9 frames, or until a key, which sets $4EB6; Y bit 0 turns multicolour off, bit 3 picks character mode, where the picture's character set is loaded ($3E2B) and its screen codes and colours, $0800 and $0BE8 on, copied to the screen

the character select: loads ALTCH.CHA (file 3), keeps it at $B000, loads the picture SELECT.GED (file 6) and draws the six portraits in two rows of three with their frames ($2630); the stick moves a flashing frame round them ($4EA6 steps the column, $4EA4 toggles the row) and shows each one's name and ability ($23F2); fire chooses, except Joey's place, the fifth, which cannot be chosen; then the choice is set up ($4D1A, full health, no power), the street's art ART0.ICN (file 11), screen (file 4) and character set are loaded, and SMALL (file 1) to $C000
